answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. What this achieves is a system where the cost of an attack is public and provable, so the whole network can trust verdicts without trusting any single identity.. The mechanism is sound because grades are sealed and only opened at close, which stops a cluster from coordinating its votes inside a single jury. Consider a orchard as the anchor of the cost.
